ambient_events: The beam swings past, and for half a second the whole basin is the colour of a cut wire.
Something under the foot of the tower shifts its weight. The water goes flat, then starts again.
The ribs hum. Not loudly: the way a wire hums, a long way off.
A gull banks hard away from the collar and does not come back.
description: The pier ends under something nobody in Coldwater built. A black hexagonal foot, a shaft that narrows to a waist thinner than a man, then flares to a wide collar. Three ribs run down it like finger bones. At the top, a faceted drum of dark glass. Every ten seconds its light comes round to you.
name: The Beacon
